title: KVFlow: Efficient Prefix Caching for Accelerating LLM-Based Multi-Agent Workflows
authors: Zaifeng Pan; Ajjkumar Patel; Zhengding Hu; Yipeng Shen; Yue Guan; Wan-Lu Li; Lianhui Qin; Yida Wang; Yufei Ding

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems use LRU-based KV cache eviction, which fails to anticipate future agent usage in multi-agent workflows, leading to frequent cache misses and high recomputation or swapping overhead.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM serving 系統採用 LRU 策略進行 KV cache eviction，無法預判多 agent workflow 中的未來使用需求，導致頻繁的 cache miss 及高昂的重計算或 swap 開銷。

key_innovation.en: KVFlow, a workflow-aware KV cache management framework that uses an Agent Step Graph to predict future agent execution and implements a fine-grained eviction policy combined with fully overlapped KV prefetching.
key_innovation.zh: KVFlow 是一個 workflow 感知的 KV cache 管理框架，利用 Agent Step Graph 預測未來 agent 執行步驟，並結合細粒度 eviction 策略與完全重疊的 KV 預取機制。

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.83x speedup for single workflows with large prompts and up to 2.19x speedup for scenarios with many concurrent workflows.
key_improvements.zh: 大 prompt 的單一 workflow 場景最高加速 1.83x；多個並發 workflow 場景最高加速 2.19x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems, Agentic Workflow
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A10G, NVIDIA H100, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-32B
offload_trigger: GPU memory pressure: when GPU memory becomes constrained, KVFlow first evicts all varying (dynamic) suffixes, then fixed-prompt prefix KV nodes in descending order of workflow-derived eviction priority, backing evicted agents' fixed-prompt KV up to CPU memory.
prefetch_signal_timing: Workflow-graph lookahead: steps-to-execution values from the Agent Step Graph identify which agents run next; their KV is asynchronously prefetched from CPU to GPU while the current agent executes, overlapping PCIe transfer with compute; status-aware scheduling dispatches requests only after loading completes.
agent_awareness: Exploits the multi-agent workflow graph: an Agent Step Graph with per-agent steps-to-execution (propagated through branching and synchronization) drives eviction priority and prefetching; also exploits multi-agent prefix sharing in the tree-structured cache and fixed-vs-dynamic prompt structure.

when_to_offload_rule.en: When GPU memory becomes constrained, first evict all varying suffixes, then evict fixed-prompt KV cache nodes in descending order of steps-to-execution-derived priority (agents furthest from next activation first), backing evicted fixed-prompt KV up to CPU memory.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 當 GPU 記憶體不足時，先逐出所有動態變化的 suffix，再依 steps-to-execution 推得之優先序由高至低逐出各 agent 固定 prompt 的 KV cache 節點（距下次執行最遠的 agent 最先被逐出），並將其卸載至 CPU 記憶體作為次級快取。
